portInfo.description: Motril’s museum, sanctuary hill, park and old-centre church offer a day with its own subject: cane sugar and the city that grew around it. Granada is not a port-side extension. A limited call should not sacrifice a proper local visit for several hours on the road and a ticket that has not been obtained.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: The authority says Dique cruise passengers travel by bus. Budget 45 minutes for port clearance/bus and a city pickup, rather than advertising a walk from a secure cargo quay. The Granada plan uses a deliberately conservative 120-minute one-way road budget, not a sourced road-time promise; validate it with the actual transport operator and cancel the excursion if the full margin cannot be preserved.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Museo Preindustrial del Azúcar — Calle Zafra 6, 18600 Motril. A specific preserved sugar-production site, not the separate Pilar factory. Allow 75 minutes; official source.

Santuario Nuestra Señora de la Cabeza — Avenida de la Constitución, Motril. Interior visits require an appointment on the municipal listing; the hill setting can be viewed without promising entry. Allow 40 minutes; official source.
Parque de los Pueblos de América — At the foot of the sanctuary hill, Motril. A planted outdoor pause between museum and hill. Allow 45 minutes; official source.
Iglesia Mayor de la Encarnación — Iglesia Mayor, Motril old centre. A religious/architectural stop, subject to worship access. Allow 35 minutes; official source.
Museo de Historia de Motril — Museo de Historia, Motril old centre. Check its restricted weekly opening before making it the afternoon anchor. Allow 60 minutes; official source.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask for the assigned quay plus return port-bus location, not just “Motril port”. A Granada driver waiting at an unauthorized cargo gate does not solve the last transfer.
